info.title: Lykia API
info.summary: Agents and stablecoins on Arc Network through one API, from a one-line quote to enterprise payouts.
info.description:
Built on Arc Network and Circle's rails. Plan money moves in plain words, check them against a Fence, hand unsigned steps to the user's wallet and follow them to finality. The server never holds user keys; intents come back unsigned. Optional server signers (a gas-only keeper, opt-in Circle developer-controlled wallets) are off unless the operator configures them.

Authenticate with `Lykia-Key` (lk_live_… or lk_test_…; test keys only reach testnet) or a `Lykia-Session` from wallet sign-in. Pin behaviour with `Lykia-Version` (2026-06-01, 2026-11-01). Send `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs. Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`; every error is `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

post.summary: Goal language -> lykia.program/v1 -> plan for now + drafts for later
post.description: The intent compiler. Reads several goals, time (every month, if BTC goes above) and abstract wording (safe, the rest, a third, out within a day) into a typed, hashed program; resolves shares, remainders and reserves against the owner's balances (or what-if balances); compiles one plan for now (route-searched under the Fence, the program digest pinned in the Fence facts) plus automation, order, alert and standing-order drafts with links to their prefilled forms; and explains assumptions, trade-offs, rejected alternatives and what is deferred. overrides change an assumption by id. Nothing is signed or saved; plan: true stores the plan for signing.

post.description: Needs LYKIA_CIRCLE_SERVER_WALLETS=true on the server (403 otherwise), the acknowledgement digest (400 AUTOPILOT_ACK_REQUIRED otherwise) and limits under the ceilings. Makes (or reuses) the owner's Circle EOA wallet and a leash on the owner's LykiaAccount with that wallet as its session key; returns the transactions the owner signs once. post.description: Nothing is signed until it is resumed; the session stays.
After a pause by the owner or by the anomaly guard (repeated refusals, unusual spend velocity).
The kill switch. Server signing stops at once, the leash and its Pack agent are revoked, and revokeSession comes back for the owner's wallet.

repay (when the account's health factor drops below a floor), dca (convert on a schedule), sweep (idle USDC above an amount into a vault), pay (a payee named when Autopilot was turned on, on a schedule), watch (one of the owner's watches, then an action). Every run is planned under the Autopilot leash and checked again before Circle signs.

Every proposal transition of the last 30 days

Lyko on watch: deterministic insights for an address (idle USDC, health factor, FX drift, runway, approvals, red-flag tokens, gas, caps, orders, agent budgets, unsettled steps, better rates), each with the figures behind it and an optional one-tap draft. Signed in as the owner: preferences, handled flags and the morning brief apply.

Herding: one list of every standing instruction (automations, standing orders and recurring payments, alerts, agent automations, LykiaOrders orders) with next run, last result and the expected Fence verdict, plus the proposals waiting for a signature

Every position the address holds in every venue Lykia supports on Arc: the wallet, Aave V4 (Main and Forex Spokes), Morpho vaults (by curator: Galaxy, Keyrock, Steakhouse, Gauntlet, Bitwise) and Morpho Blue markets, Uniswap v3 and v4, Aerodrome Slipstream, Archery, Unitflow Finance V3 and SushiSwap V3 LP NFTs, USYC, the Circle Gateway unified balance and, for the proven owner, CCTP and Relay transfers in flight, open LykiaOrders orders and scheduled payments. Each position carries its amount, USD value, state (earning, idle, borrowing, at-risk, out-of-range, pending, escrowed, committed), what it is doing, APY, health, range and fees where they apply, one-tap Lyko actions, its source (chain, api, history), the block and an explorer link. A venue that cannot be read comes back unavailable with the reason, never as zero. Each venue is read with its own time limit and cached for 20 seconds per address.

post.summary: Put an agent on a leash
post.description: One call: a Pack agent whose Fence is a strict subset of its parent's, a daily budget carved from the parent, the unsigned LykiaAccount session transaction (createSession from the owner, or createSubSession from the parent agent's session key) with per-token caps, payees, call rules, expiry and the Fence hash, a leash key shown once, a ready MCP config and optionally an ERC-8004 Tag registration. With spendFrom gateway the money is the owner's Circle Gateway balance: the response carries the owner's LykiaStile (its creation when there is none), addDelegate on Gateway Wallet and createSession on the Stile instead of a LykiaAccount session. Owner only: a Lykia-Session, or a secret key with the agents scope that may act for the owner.

owner.description: Defaults to the signed-in address; required with a project key acting through consent.

signer.description: The agent's own address: it becomes the LykiaAccount session key. Lykia never sees its private key.

parentAgentId.description: A Pack agent to carve the leash from (its Fence and budget bound the leash).

name.description: With parentAgentId: the new sub-agent's name.

signer.description: With parentAgentId: the new sub-agent's session key address.

spendFrom.description: "arc" (default): the owner's LykiaAccount on Arc. "gateway": the owner's Circle Gateway balance through LykiaStile, where it is switched on (see GET /v1/leashes/templates).

destinations.description: "gateway" only: Gateway chains the agent may pay to, e.g. ["arc", "base"].

maxGatewayFeeUsd.description: "gateway" only: Circle's fee per burn intent the session allows (default $0.10, at most $5).

get.description: The owner, or the leash's own key.

post.description: For the leash key. The Fence with the leash's own spend, the leash's total, spendable() per token and the session's call rules and payees on chain, then a simulation from the session key. Inside: the intent and its first step as one transaction for the session key. Outside: 422 LEASH_DENIED with reason codes and the remaining budget. A Gateway leash plans one transfer: the burn intents (payment and Lykia's fee leg) and the reserve transaction on the owner's LykiaStile, in prepared.gateway.

forward.description: Gateway leashes: ask Circle's Forwarding Service to submit the mint on the destination (its fee comes from Gateway's estimate).

post.description: A new carve, a new session and a new key; the old leash is revoked. Never an increase in place.

The leash key stops working at once and the carve returns to the parent. Returns the unsigned revokeSession(id) for the owner's wallet; once signed the session and every sub-session under it end on chain.
With txHash: read from its SessionCreated event. Without: found among the session ids issued since the leash was made.

The hash of the transaction the session key sent. Checked against the prepared one, settled from its receipt, counted against the leash; the next step comes back prepared. For a Gateway leash the reservation is proven from its Reserved event, then the burn intents go to Gateway's /v1/transfer with contractSigner true; the attestation and the unsigned gatewayMint come back (status pending while Gateway cannot see the reservation yet: submit the same hash again).

get.description: Plans, denials and transactions, each cross-checked with the chain: chain-proven when the receipt succeeded, carries AgentCall or AgentTransfer for the session and its AgentMemo names the same intent, step and verdict. Session events Lykia has no record of are listed as source chain.

LykiaKey.name: Lykia-Key
LykiaKey.description: API key. Scopes: read (Every GET: networks, venues, the Flock, Scent, intents, logs and usage.); quote (Quotes and checks that move nothing: route search, quotes, Fence evaluate and validate, sentence parsing.); build (Plans and unsigned transactions: create intents, prepare steps, Tag drafts, MCP.); execute (Record signed transactions and control running plans: submit, stop.); agents (The Pack and Lyko's agent: spawn, revoke, chat.); automation (Standing orders, limit orders, alerts and agent automations.); payouts (Business money movement: payouts, invoices and treasury flows.); admin (Account settings: keys, webhooks, projects, billing.); plan (Legacy: implies quote, build and execute.); webhooks (Legacy: manage webhook endpoints.)

LykiaSession.name: Lykia-Session
LykiaSession.description: Session token from POST /v1/auth/verify (SIWE on Arc).

X402.name: X-PAYMENT
X402.description: x402 payment (USDC on Arc) for paid routes and pay-as-you-go overage.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 8 to 128 characters. Retries with the same key and body replay the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different body is 409.

LykiaVersion.name: Lykia-Version
LykiaVersion.description: API version date. Defaults to the key's pinned version, else 2026-11-01.

RequestId.description: Unique id of this request; quote it to support.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests per minute allowed for this key.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

LykiaVersion.description: The API version that served the request.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks a scope, the IP or origin is not allowed, or a test key asked for mainnet (LIVE_MODE_REQUIRED).

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used with a different body, or the first request is still running.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Retry-After says when.

PaymentRequired.description: x402 payment required: { x402Version, error, accepts: [PaymentRequirements] }.

ServerError.description: An internal or upstream failure. Safe to retry GETs; retry POSTs with the same Idempotency-Key.
